name: Kobay Technology Bhd.
overview: 2026 年 Kobay 的公告主要涉及与关联方 UA Materials Sdn. Bhd. 的经常性关联交易实际金额超出股东授权上限，涉及 Precision Manufacturing 板块下的 Paradigm Precision Components、Paradigm Metal Industries 及持股 51% 的 Kual Technologies；此外公司发布了 2026 年报及截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止年度的经审计财务报表。公告中未披露新增业务线、产能扩张、合约签订或业务出售事项。
overview_en: In 2026, Kobay's announcements mainly concerned recurrent related party transactions with UA Materials Sdn. Bhd. exceeding the shareholders' mandate, involving Paradigm Precision Components, Paradigm Metal Industries and 51%-owned Kual Technologies under the Precision Manufacturing segment; the company also released its 2026 Annual Report and audited financial statements for the year ended 30 June 2026.

segments.name: 精密制造
segments.note: 今年该板块的公告均为与关联方 UA Materials Sdn. Bhd. 的经常性关联交易实际金额超出股东授权上限。
segments.note_en: This year's announcements for the segment relate to recurrent related party transactions with UA Materials Sdn. Bhd. exceeding the shareholders' mandate.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RECURRENT RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 全资子公司 Paradigm Precision Components Sdn. Bhd. 与 UA Materials Sdn. Bhd. 的经常性关联交易实际金额超出 2025 年 10 月 31 日通函所披露的估计上限逾 10%。
actions.text_en: The actual value of recurrent related party transactions between wholly-owned subsidiary Paradigm Precision Components Sdn. Bhd. and UA Materials Sdn. Bhd. exceeded the estimated aggregate value disclosed in the 31 October 2025 circular by more than 10%.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RECURRENT RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 全资子公司 Paradigm Metal Industries Sdn. Bhd. 与 UA Materials Sdn. Bhd. 的经常性关联交易实际金额超出授权估计上限 49.13%。
actions.text_en: The actual value of recurrent related party transactions between wholly-owned subsidiary Paradigm Metal Industries Sdn. Bhd. and UA Materials Sdn. Bhd. exceeded the mandated estimated aggregate value by 49.13%.
